description: 대구광역시 동구_저수지 현황 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대구광역시 동구. 이를 통해 행정기관은 저수지 관리, 홍수 예방, 수자원 계획 수립에 활용할 수 있으며, 연구자와 개발자는 데이터를 활용해 수자원 관리 시스템, 홍수 모니터링, 환경 분석, 지도 기반. Coverage: 대구광역시 동구. The portal files it under the publisher 대구광역시 동구. Its tags are 저수지, 면적, 준공년도, 수자원관리, 홍수예방. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-08-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
